name: Tidewarm
tagline: Warm in two minutes after any swim
positioning: Changing robes and recovery layers for people who swim outdoors all year. Built for the five minutes after the swim, priced below the category leader and sized for smaller swimmers too.

targetAudience.summary: UK open-water swimmers aged 28–55 who dip through the winter, often in clubs.

personas.name: Club dipper
personas.description: Swims with a group every weekend from October to March and changes in a car park.

personas.name: Gift buyer
personas.description: Buys a robe for a partner who has started cold-water swimming.

doList: Talk about the minutes after the swim

typography.rationale: A warm serif for headings, a plain sans for reading.

identity.logoBrief: A simple wave inside a circle, one colour, works at favicon size.
identity.imageryDirection: Early-morning beaches, steam rising off swimmers, real people in robes.

story.about:
We started swimming in the sea through a Scottish winter and could never get warm fast enough.

Tidewarm is the robe we wanted.
story.mission: Make the minutes after a cold swim the best part of it.

products.title: Tidewarm Changing Robe
products.description:
A waterproof, fleece-lined robe you can change under on any beach.

The shell keeps wind and rain out; the lining dries fast.
imagePrompts: A swimmer in a navy robe on a misty beach at dawn
